candidates.change_summary: Change the return statement from `return true;` to `return false;` so successful calls return false instead of true.
Delete the msg.sender authorization check so any caller can execute the batch transfer.
Delete the require that _tos.length > 0 so an empty call loop does nothing and returns true.
Change the transfer amount multiplier from 1e18 to 1 wei so the transferred amounts differ.
Transfer from msg.sender instead of the fixed `from` address, changing which account funds are drawn from.
Change the token selector from transferFrom to transfer so the low-level call targets a different token method.
